data.description:
# Bug / task

## Goal

The Main Street 'Serial Seller' challenge (added in tce-main-street commit `db2edf1`, tracked by sibling work item `MS-0MUOLL8W2004A3D7`) has a Steam achievement mapping (`serial-seller` -> `TCE_MAIN_STREET_SERIAL_SELLER`), but the launcher's achievement manifest on core `dev` omits it. A commit adding the entry exists on the unmerged branch `wl-MS-0MUOLL8W2004A3D7-serial-seller` (`d2d1f322`), but it was never integrated into `dev`, so:

- the launcher cannot unlock the Serial Seller achievement, and
- the sibling Main Street drift-guard test fails once its `./core` submodule is pinned to core `dev`.

Discovered while completing `CG-0MUL2G17U003C1N6` (its cross-repo sibling commit needs a core `dev` commit that has both the new ToneForge runtime module and this manifest entry). Relationship: `discovered-from:CG-0MUL2G17U003C1N6`; this item blocks the sibling cross-repo commit of `CG-0MUL2G17U003C1N6`.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `electron/achievement-manifest.json` contains the `serial-seller` entry (`TCE_MAIN_STREET_SERIAL_SELLER`, `hidden: false`) for `main-street`.
2. `tests/steam-achievements/steam-achievements.test.ts` expects the updated count and passes.
3. `npm run build` passes; the affected core steam-achievement unit tests pass.
4. Pushed to core `dev`.
data.title: Sync the launcher achievement manifest with game achievement mappings (core dev)
